title: Fix install path: @quarkos/cairn with CLI, public assets, and portable MCP
body: ## Problem `npx cairn` resolved to Adam Terlson’s 2017 React Native styling package (`cairn@0.8.0`), not QuarkOS Cairn. The GitHub tree was also missing `cli/` and `public/`, so a GitHub-based install could not boot. README documented a false install path, Claude Code was undocumented, Pi MCP config used Cursor-only `${workspaceFolder}`, and the MCP server version lagged the package (`0.3.0` vs `0.4.0`). A first `npm publish` attempt then hit two blockers: npm stripped `bin.cairn` (`"bin[cairn]" script name … was invalid and removed` when the path used a `./` prefix / non-executable file), and `PUT …/@quarkos%2fcairn` 404’d because the `@quarkos` org is not set up on npmjs.com. ## Changes - Rename the npm package to **`@quarkos/cairn`** (avoids the `cairn@0.8.0` collision). - Restore boot files: `cli/main.ts`, `public/`, core store lib, Next.js desk/canvas/API. - Document install via `npx --yes github:QuarkOS/Cairn` (works before publish) and `@quarkos/cairn` after publish. Never bare `npx cairn`. - README covers Cursor, Claude Code, and Pi MCP wiring. - `init --project` writes: - `.cursor/mcp.json` with `${workspaceFolder}` (Cursor) - `.mcp.json` with an **absolute** `CAIRN_HOME` (Pi + Claude Code) - Align MCP server version to **0.4.0** with the package. - Keep `bin.cairn` as `bin/cairn.mjs` (no `./`), shebang + executable bit, so `npm pack` / publish retain the bin. - Note that first scoped publish needs the `@quarkos` org on npmjs.com and `--access public`. ## Verification From an empty throwaway folder, `node bin/cairn.mjs init --project` seeded `.cairn/cairn.db`, wrote portable `.mcp.json` (no `${workspaceFolder}`), and `recall` returned seeded beliefs. Tarball install also worked. `verify-cairn` suite passed on port 14721: doctor, HTTP assert/recall, CLI recall, canvas layout API, retract. `npm pack` keeps `bin.cairn` → `bin/cairn.mjs` with no invalid-bin warning; installed tarball links `node_modules/.bin/cairn`. [Cairn desk](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-0641c217-7a5f-41c8-b9ae-cdd29949140d/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fscreenshots%2Fcairn-desk.png) [Cairn agent canvas](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-0641c217-7a5f-41c8-b9ae-cdd29949140d/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fscreenshots%2Fcairn-canvas.png) ## Install after merge ```bash npx --yes github:QuarkOS/Cairn init --project npx --yes github:QuarkOS/Cairn dev ``` After creating the `@quarkos` org on npmjs.com and `npm publish --access public`, prefer `@quarkos/cairn` (or set `CAIRN_NPX_SPEC=@quarkos/cairn` when regenerating MCP configs). To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.

title: Fix post-publish MCP, init defaults, and dual-React desk API
body: ## Summary Fixes the blockers that break a fresh `@quarkos/cairn@0.4.x` install after the scoped publish. - **`cairn mcp`**: stop depending on `@/lib` path aliases at runtime (relative imports in the MCP server + `--tsconfig` for the package when cwd is a consumer project). - **`init --project`**: default `CAIRN_NPX_SPEC` to `@quarkos/cairn` (override still works for `github:QuarkOS/Cairn`). Templates, desk Install panel, and README match. - **`/api/cairn` dual-React / Turbopack**: ship TypeScript + Tailwind as runtime deps so Next does not auto-`npm install` into the package (that created a second React). Pin Turbopack to the package root and, on first `cairn dev`/`start` from a hoisted install, materialize a hermetic local Next runtime under the package. - Patch bump to **0.4.1** for a follow-up publish. ## Verified locally (packed tarball) 1. `cairn mcp` boots and `tools/list` returns `cairn_recall` / `cairn_request` (server version `0.4.1`) — no `@/lib` error. 2. `init --project` writes `-y @quarkos/cairn mcp` into `.cursor/mcp.json` and `.mcp.json`; `CAIRN_NPX_SPEC=github:QuarkOS/Cairn` still overrides. 3. First `cairn dev` prepares a one-time local runtime, then `GET /api/cairn` returns `200` with `kind: recalled`. Assert + recall round-trip works. Second `cairn dev` skips the one-time install. ```bash npx --yes @quarkos/cairn@0.4.1 init --project # after publish npx --yes @quarkos/cairn mcp npx --yes @quarkos/cairn dev ``` Do not use bare `npx cairn` (unrelated `cairn@0.8.0`).

title: Make init MCP args follow the install source
body: ## Problem `init --project` always wrote `@quarkos/cairn` into generated MCP configs. After a GitHub install (`npx github:QuarkOS/Cairn`), MCP still hit the registry package, which could be an older tarball (the `@/lib` crash on 0.4.0). ## Fix `CAIRN_NPX_SPEC` still wins when set. Otherwise init detects the install source: - Local checkout (`.git` present) → absolute package path - npx / dependency parent `package.json` or lockfile → `github:Org/Repo` or `@quarkos/cairn` - Unknown → `@quarkos/cairn` Version bumped to **0.4.2** (no publish in this PR). ## Proof - Unit tests in `cli/npx-install-spec.test.ts` - E2E: local → `/workspace`, fake GitHub npx parent → `github:QuarkOS/Cairn`, fake npm parent → `@quarkos/cairn`, env override respected

title: Pin CAIRN_HOME for cairn dev, keep canvas off Node fs, skip demo seed
body: Fixes the remaining 0.4.1 product bugs: canvas client graph, `cairn dev` using the npx package as the SQLite home, and init silently loading demo facts. ## What changed **Canvas.** Layout types live in a client-safe module. The `/canvas` page is a server entry that renders a client board. `GET/PUT /api/cairn/canvas` stays on the Node runtime. The client no longer imports the `fs` canvas store. `/canvas` is dynamic, not a static HTML snapshot. **`cairn dev` / `cairn start`.** Next.js still starts with cwd = the installed package (it has to, for `next.config.ts`). Before spawn, the CLI pins `CAIRN_HOME` from: 1. `CAIRN_HOME` if already set 2. `./.cairn` in the directory you ran the command from (or `INIT_CWD` when cwd is already the package) 3. `~/.cairn` So `init --project` then `cairn dev` from a throwaway folder talks to **that** folder’s `.cairn`, not the npx cache. `CAIRN_HOME` is the override if you need a different store. **Init.** A new database is empty. `init --demo` (and `POST /api/cairn/reset`) load the sample beliefs. Patch **0.4.2**. ## Proof (this run) Packed tarball install in `/tmp/cairn-throw-042` with `CAIRN_HOME` unset: - `init --project` created `/tmp/cairn-throw-042/.cairn/cairn.db` and `recall` returned `beliefs: []` - `cairn dev --port 14725` logged `Cairn desk: CAIRN_HOME=/tmp/cairn-throw-042/.cairn` - `GET /`, `/api/cairn`, `/canvas`, `/api/cairn/canvas` all **200**. Canvas HTML contains `Agent canvas`. PUT wrote `canvas.json` in the project. - POST assert landed in the **project** sqlite (1 row, `dev.home.marker`). No `cairn.db` under the package. - `init --project --demo` in a sibling dir recalled 10 sample beliefs. `verify-cairn` on port 14721: doctor, HTTP assert/recall, canvas page + layout API, CLI recall (11 then 10 after retract of a demo fact), retract. Production `/canvas` rendered pods (`mira`, `session:s-015`, …) and a pod drag saved layout. No 500. ```bash unset CAIRN_HOME CAIRN_DB_PATH mkdir /tmp/cairn-throw && cd /tmp/cairn-throw npx --yes @quarkos/cairn@0.4.2 init --project # after publish npx --yes @quarkos/cairn@0.4.2 dev --port 4721 ```

body: ## Problem `next build` typecheck fails on Windows after `npm publish` tests pass (28/28): ``` cli/npx-install-spec.test.ts(141,28): error TS2345: Argument of type '{ CAIRN_NPX_SPEC: string; }' is not assignable to parameter of type 'ProcessEnv'. title: Fix cairn dev under low Linux inotify caps
body: ## Summary `cairn dev` (Turbopack) was exhausting Linux `fs.inotify.max_user_instances` (commonly 128). Setting `WATCHPACK_POLLING` alone does **not** fix this — Turbopack ignores that env and still native-watches until it panics / 500s the desk. - Set `watchOptions.pollIntervalMs` in `next.config.ts` so Turbopack polls - Have `cairn dev` inject `WATCHPACK_POLLING` / Chokidar polling (Watchpack still uses native watches under Turbopack without this) - Route `npm run dev` / `start` through the CLI so the same path applies - `cairn start` stays on `next start` (no file watchers) Base is `codex/sol-max-reliability-042` (PR #7) since that work is still unmerged. ## Verification - `npm test` (36 passing) - `npm run build` (TypeScript + production build OK in repo) - Packed tarball install with **126/128** inotify instances held open, `max_user_instances=128`: - CLI injects `WATCHPACK_POLLING=true` / `CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true` - `GET /`, `/canvas`, `/api/cairn`, `/api/cairn/canvas` all **200** - No Turbopack FATAL / Watchpack EMFILE in the log - Confirmed regression: `WATCHPACK_POLLING` alone still FATAL under the same cap; config poll + CLI env succeeds No npm publish. SQLite tx / init / MCP contract untouched.

title: Enforce append-only SQLite persistence
body:
## Summary

- persist ordinary fact, retraction, and idempotency-stamp writes as insert-only suffixes
- reject removal, mutation, reordering, or duplicate keys atomically at the persistence boundary
- route saveStoreToDb through the same invariant while retaining resetDb as the explicit destructive reset
- read rows in insertion order and cover the invariant with SQLite mutation guards

## Why

Cairn is an append-only fact store, but the normal transaction path deleted every SQLite row and reinserted the full in-memory store for each write. That preserved logical history while violating the storage guarantee and rewriting prior rows.

This change leaves existing schemas and JSON/MCP contracts unchanged. Ordinary writes now insert only newly appended rows; attempts to alter prior history fail before any delta is committed.

## Stack

This PR is stacked on #12 so it contains only the persistence change and focused tests. It does not duplicate #11 or #12, touch PR #8 work, or modify Pi-Fusion.

## Verification

- npm test — 43 passing
- npm run build — passed
- focused persistence suite — 3 passing
- changed-file ESLint — 0 errors
- git diff --check — passed

No npm publish was performed.

title: Add Claude Code project rules and a two-session demo

Project facts go through `cairn_assert`, `cairn_recall`, and `cairn_retract`. Do not write them into MEMORY.md. - **DEMO.md** is how to reproduce two sessions. Session one asserts desk port 4721, npm name `@quarkos/cairn`, and CAIRN_HOME resolution order. Session two starts a new process, recalls with `freshness: "fresh"`, then retracts one fact. - **demo/two-session.ts** runs those writes through `handleRequest` (the same function MCP tools and the CLI use). Observed `response.kind` values are recorded in DEMO.md, not invented. - `.mcp.json` and `.cairn/` remain gitignored. Data model unchanged. title: Add Cursor Agent Plugin for @quarkos/cairn
body: Ship marketplace-ready Agent Plugin source for Cairn at the repo root so this public git repo can later be listed on the Cursor plugin marketplace. ## Honest limit This plugin helps **Cursor IDE users on the installer's machine**. It does **not** inject facts into Cursor cloud agent VMs. Those remotes cannot see the installer's SQLite store. ## Out of scope - Do **not** submit at https://cursor.com/marketplace/publish - Do **not** npm publish - MCP tool implementations are unchanged - Verification-skill follow-up edits **only** `.cursor/skills/verify-cairn/` (no product code) ## What this adds - Root `plugin.json` (Agent Plugins 1.0.0, name `cairn`, version `0.4.5`) - Root `mcp.json`: stdio server `cairn` via `npx -y @quarkos/cairn mcp` - Cursor overlay `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` **only** for optional `CAIRN_HOME` (Agent Plugins has no `variables`). No rules, hooks, agents, or commands. - Thin skills: `cairn-recall` and `cairn-assert` (do not invent facts; unique `idempotencyKey`; `onConflict: supersede` for live facts) - README usage + config for the plugin - Tiny store-resolution guard: empty or unsubstituted `${CAIRN_HOME}` is treated as unset so native resolution still applies (`CAIRN_HOME`, else `./.cairn`, else `~/.cairn`) `cwd` is omitted on purpose. Do not set it to `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` — that would look for `./.cairn` inside the plugin install directory. Point `CAIRN_HOME` at the installer's project `.cairn` after `npx -y @quarkos/cairn init --project`. Never pin a coordinator path such as `/home/box/cairn-loop/.cairn`. The npm package is always **`@quarkos/cairn`**. Never the unscoped `cairn` package. ## Verification skill map (follow-up on this PR) Only `.cursor/skills/verify-cairn/` in the map commits. No second PR. - `features/cli-init-recall.md` + `scripts/drive-cli-init.sh`: `init --project` always uses `/.cairn` and ignores `CAIRN_HOME`; `--demo` refuses a non-empty store; empty string and literal `${CAIRN_HOME}` are treated as unset (this checkout; published 0.4.5 lacks the guard until a later npm release) - `features/desk-beliefs-table.md`: chips are full ids (`env:staging`); desk does not poll (curl assert needs Send/Retract or reload); `+N more` needs more than five entities (demo has four) - `features/cursor-agent-plugin.md` + `scripts/drive-cursor-plugin.sh`: plugin manifests and skills, file-only proof (no IDE injection on cloud VMs) - `features/retract-fact.md`: MCP `cairn_retract` is a sibling surface, not the HTTP/desk proof ### Re-drove vs docs-only - Re-drove `drive-cli-init.sh` (PASS): ignored `CAIRN_HOME`, `--demo` refusal, overlay recall against `./.cairn` - Re-drove `drive-cursor-plugin.sh` (PASS): manifests + skills, `@quarkos/cairn`, no coordinator pin - Did **not** relaunch the desk: swarm already proved live chip ids, no polling, and `+N more` vs four demo entities. Desk drive recipe text was corrected to match that. ## Proof in this PR (VM) - `plugin.json` and `mcp.json` validate against Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schemas (`Draft202012Validator`) - `npx -y @quarkos/cairn --help` from `/tmp` prints the published 0.4.5 CLI (run outside the checkout so local `package.json` does not intercept) - MCP `initialize` + `tools/list` against `npx -y @quarkos/cairn mcp` with a throwaway `CAIRN_HOME`: server `cairn@0.4.5`, tools `cairn_recall`, `cairn_assert`, `cairn_retract`, `cairn_request` - Same handshake with this branch's CLI when `CAIRN_HOME` is `""` or the literal `${CAIRN_HOME}` - `npm test` (45 pass) including the optional-`CAIRN_HOME` path tests Local Cursor load via `~/.cursor/plugins/local` is left for the coordinator after this PR exists.

title: Honest TTL: replace lying reverify validity
body: `validity.kind: "reverify"` plus `command` claimed a probe that Cairn never ran. This replaces it with honest TTL. ## Contract - `Validity` is now `{ kind: "until-superseded" } | { kind: "ttl"; staleAfterSeconds } | { kind: "expires"; at }` - `freshnessOf` uses the same clock math as the old reverify branch. No command. No `child_process`. `execute()` stays pure. - Freshness stays advisory. On stale, the agent re-observes outside Cairn and asserts with `supersede`. - Append-only: inbound and on-disk `reverify` + finite `staleAfterSeconds` coerce to `{ kind: "ttl", staleAfterSeconds }`. `command` is dropped. Rows are not superseded, so `assertedAt` is unchanged. No provenance is invented from the dropped command. ## Compatibility New asserts should send `ttl`. Legacy `reverify` is accepted for one minor (HTTP, disk load, and MCP inbound) and stored as `ttl`. MCP does not advertise `reverify` as a first-class outbound kind. ## Version Public `Validity` type break → **0.5.0** (package, lockfile, MCP `serverInfo`, plugin manifests, README). Out of scope: Candidate B (`record-reverify` / tickets / no-op-assert reject), running shell on recall, npm publish. ## Proof `npm test`: 52 pass, 0 fail. `npx tsc --noEmit` still reports pre-existing `cli/main.test.ts` `ProcessEnv` errors; none in this change. `npm run lint` still reports pre-existing Remotion/desk hook issues; changed files are clean aside from the existing unused `_nowMs` warning.
